name: Script panel example
description: Small schema v5 example: reads a metric, remembers a setting and builds its own panel.
author: PBS SDK

runtime.source:
-- Minimal schema v5 plugin.
local function state(key, fallback)
  local value = pbs.store.get(key)
  if value == nil then return fallback end
  return value
end

pbs.ui.panel("main", "Script panel", function()
  pbs.ui.metric("stream.resolution", "Stream")
  pbs.ui.metric("stream.decoder", "Decoder")
  local note = pbs.ui.input("note", "Your note", state("note", ""))
  pbs.store.set("note", note)
  local clicks = state("clicks", 0)
  if pbs.ui.button("count", "Count one more") then
    clicks = clicks + 1
    pbs.store.set("clicks", clicks)
    pbs.notify("Script panel", "Counted " .. clicks)
  end
  pbs.ui.note("Button presses: " .. clicks)
  if pbs.ui.button("settings", "Open streaming settings") then
    pbs.navigate("open.settings.streaming")
  end
end, "A complete v5 example written in Lua")
